invariant_patterns.brief: Composite unique constraint on (sku, location): no two rows share the same SKU/location pair (NFR R3).
CHECK quantity >= 0: a stock quantity can never be persisted below zero (NFR R2).
sku, location, and quantity are NOT NULL; a stock record cannot exist without its identifying pair and quantity.
A refile of an existing (sku, location) pair is a single atomic upsert; on collision the existing row is updated in one transaction, never inserted as a duplicate (NFR R3, AC3).
The Alembic migration creating the stock table has a working downgrade and preserves pre-existing inventory records on upgrade (NFR R1).
